title: Read the tracebacks
hints: README → New syntax: `-U`, `\n` inside the pattern, and a non-capturing group `(?:...)`.
Shape: the `Traceback` line, then one or more lines starting with two spaces, then the exception line (capture that one).
`rg -U -o -r '$1' 'Traceback.*\n(?:...)+(.+)' "$DATA/deploy.log"`: the group is two spaces, the rest of the line, `\n`.
